description: channel=email: Add an email outcome rule. channel=sms: Add an SMS outcome rule.

diagnostic.description: The diagnostic text sent with the SMTP code.

is_enabled.description: Off rules are kept but skipped.

match_field.description: Match the pattern against the recipient (`to`) or the sender (`from`).

note.description: Why the rule exists, shown in the list.

outcome.description:
What happens to a matching message: `reject` (the send fails), `undelivered`, `failed`,
`delayed_delivery` or `read`.

pattern.description: Exact E.164 number, or `*` for any digits, e.g. `+1555777*`.

smtp_code.description: SMTP reply for bounces and rejects, e.g. `550 5.1.1`.
